old: जैसे सोना चार से परखा जाता है, घिसने, काटने, तपाने और पीटने से, वैसे ही पुरुष चार से परखा जाता है, त्याग, शील, गुण और कर्म से।

old: Fear is to be felt in fears as long as the fear has not come; but having seen the fear come, one is to strike without hesitation.

why: reviewer (minor): tāvat ... yāvat is a correlative pair; the first member 'so long' is not rendered.
reviewer (error): Labelled bahuvrīhi; it is a tat-puruṣa (arisen from one womb, ablative relation), with eka-udara inside.
reviewer (error): Labelled bahuvrīhi; it is a tat-puruṣa (born in/under one star, locative relation).

new: अन्याय से कमाए धन से भरा पेट, गर्व से ऊँचा सिर: अरे अरे सियार, शीघ्र छोड़ दे, छोड़ दे, नीच, अत्यन्त निन्दनीय शरीर को। निःस्पृह अधिकारी नहीं होगा, कामनारहित मनुष्य श्रृंगार का प्रेमी नहीं होता; अनिपुण प्रिय नहीं बोलेगा, स्पष्ट बोलने वाला ठग नहीं होता।
why: reviewer (minor): Without a comma after 'छोड़ दे', 'नीच' reads as a vocative; it is an adjective of vapuḥ, like sunindyam.

old: The belly full of wealth gained unjustly, the head high with pride: ho, ho, jackal, give up at once, give up the low, highly blameworthy body. One free from longing would not be one holding authority, one without desire is not fond of ornament; an unskilled man would not speak what is pleasant, a plain speaker is not a deceiver.
new: The belly full of wealth gained unjustly, the head high with pride: ho, ho, jackal, give up at once, give up the low, highly blameworthy body. why: reviewer (minor): syāt (optative) is carried over from the first clause, so the English should match 'would not be'.
